Name: Dardelyon's Crops
Author: sandroxstardew11
Description:
New Crops:[list]
[*][b]Raspberries[/b]
A seasonal treat that grows in [b]Summer/Spring[/b]. These delicious berries thrive in warmer climates, offering a juicy, refreshing harvest perfect for crafting jams, wines, and new recipes. Raspberries are a great source of income, with the potential for high profits when sold fresh or preserved. Harvest them multiple times during the season to keep your farm stocked with these sweet, tangy berries.[*][b]Glacier Leek[/b]
A hardy, cool-weather crop that grows in [b]Winter/Fall[/b], the Glacier Leek adds a unique touch to your winter garden. With its striking blue hue and robust flavor, this leek can be used in cooking or sold at the market. It has a fast growth cycle compared to other winter crops, but the rewards are well worth it. Ideal for those who want to stay productive during the cold months when most crops are dormant.[*][b]Southern Sugarcane[/b]
This [b]Summer [/b] crop thrives in humid conditions, perfect for regions that experience warmth and rain. The Southern Sugarcane is a slow-growing crop that provides a sweet, sugar-rich harvest perfect for a great paycheck. A great addition to your farm for those looking to add some sweetness to their crops. It also sells for a decent profit, making it a valuable seasonal investment.[*][b]Ravenclaw Berries[/b]
A rare and mystical berry that can only be grown in the [b]Fall[/b] season, Ravenclaw Berries have a mysterious black hue and a complex, bittersweet flavor. These berries are highly sought after for their unique properties. With a moderate growth time, Ravenclaw Berries will give your farm a touch of mystery, and their high selling price makes them an excellent choice for those looking to increase their farm’s income.CREDITS:[/list]To Cornucopia - More Crops authors: I would like to credit them because I used some of their artwork on my sprites. You can download their mod here on Nexus at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508.
